Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/specification_section_revisions?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&specification_section_division_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&all_revisions=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
